notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
